query: INSERT INTO merge_candidates (id, series_id, candidate_id, score, reason, resolved, outcome, resolved_by, resolved_at) VALUES ($1, LEAST($2::uuid, $3::uuid), GREATEST($2::uuid, $3::uuid), 0, 'operator marked distinct', true, 'dismissed', $4, now()) ON CONFLICT (series_id, candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET resolved = true, outcome = 'dismissed', resolved_by = $4, resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now()
